Distribution. Known from a few scattered localities in Sudano-Guinean woodland savannas in E Guinea, Ivory Coast, Ghana, SW Niger, and Benin; it probably occurs more widely in W Africa. Descriptive notes. Head-body 145 mm, tail 172 mm, ear 17 - 23 mm, hindfoot 33 mm; weight 111 g. A large gerbil, Giffard’s Gerbil has a tail slightly longer (120 %) than head-body length and with a discrete terminal tuft. Chromosomal complementis 2 n = 46, FN = 64.
